ROLE: story-data engineer plus test author. TASK: audit the Act 2 missed-window recoveries in scenes 2A and 2C for the flaw just fixed in 2B, prove each case with a real-engine test, and fix the data only where a test proves the flaw.

THE FLAW (already fixed for 2B in commit b0afd8b5; read data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml event `audit_recovery_2b` and tests/test_2c_ledger_guard.py `test_2b_outcome_blocks_late_audit_recovery` as the model). A pacing "recovery" event (sets a `*_recovery_ready` fact) has no check that the player already earned an outcome, so after the player's real choice it still fires and its recovery bridge asserts extra outcome/cost facts on top of the real ones, leaving contradictory ledger facts.

KNOWN SUSPECT, scene 2A. pacing.yaml event `inspection_recovery_2a` (turn 7) requires only inspection_window_missed and supervisor_escorting. Its sibling `inspection_nudge_2a` (turn 6) is guarded by `restricted_corridor_access == false`. The recovery bridge `bridge_2a_missed_window_recovery` (storylet-routes.yaml ~3078) asserts restricted_corridor_access, rebecca_observing_infiltrators, inspection_console_used and `cover_suspected` (the COST of the doubted outcome). So a player who stalls past turn 5, gets the turn-6 nudge, then earns the CONVINCING outcome (see incidents.yaml `i_2a_real_leak`: outcomes inspection_convincing / inspection_doubted, their knowledge ids k_sl_2a_c_r5 / k_sl_2a_c_r6, observation k_sl_2a_b_r1 gates them) ends with supervisor_convinced AND cover_suspected both true. The game-reimagination plan records this symptom ("the canonical scripted journey ... ends with supervisor_convinced and cover_suspected both true"). `cover_suspected` is read by the 2B entry variant in plot.md, so it also puts a false line in the 2B opening for a convinced player.

SUSPECT TO CHECK, scene 2C. `purge_nudge_2c` (turn 6) is guarded by committed_to_transmit == false and committed_to_rescue == false; `purge_recovery_2c` (turn 6) requires purge_window_missed and purge_alarm_active and has no commitment guard; `bridge_2c_missed_window_recovery` (storylet-routes.yaml ~3180) asserts rebecca_offer_active, antagonist_split_known, purge_clock_started, evidence_ready_to_transmit, ..., purge_alarm_active, purge_recovery_ready, combined_broadcast_rescue_plan_known and by design NO commitment. Determine BY TEST whether a 2C player can end with a commitment fact (committed_to_transmit or committed_to_rescue) TOGETHER with the recovery's facts (purge_recovery_ready, combined_broadcast_rescue_plan_known true while the scene should have ended by choice), or with both commitments, in any of these timings: commit before turn 5; at turn 5; at turn 6; at turn 7; after reading the observation k_sl_2c_c_r1 or without it. Learn the engine ordering empirically (within a turn, are reveal effects committed before pacing events? the 2B test shows they are).

DO:
1. Write tests in a NEW file tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py, on the REAL package, driving the real engine with a scripted provider that selects knowledge ids (copy the small `_ScriptedProvider`, `_drive`, `_true_facts` helpers and the 1A-to-2A prefix list from tests/test_2c_ledger_guard.py; do not import private names from other test modules). Name every 2A test with `_2a_` in the function name and every 2C test with `_2c_` in the function name. 2A: for BOTH outcomes (convincing, doubted) and for the outcome earned at 2A turn 5, 6 and 7 (after the observation k_sl_2a_b_r1), assert: the chosen outcome's advantage fact is true, the OTHER outcome's advantage/cost facts are NOT true (in particular convincing => cover_suspected is not true; doubted => supervisor_convinced is not true), and inspection_recovery_ready is never true after the choice. Also one 2A case where the player earns NO outcome and stalls: recovery still fires and the scene still exits (tests/test_stall_exit_audit.py covers this and must still pass unchanged). 2C: parameterize over the timings listed above for both commitments and assert no contradictory facts (never both commitments; a commitment never coexists with purge_recovery_ready); assert the neutral staller still gets purge_recovery_ready and exits with no commitment.
2. FIX only what a test proves broken, data only, in data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml: for `inspection_recovery_2a`, add to its `when` the same guard that `inspection_nudge_2a` has (`restricted_corridor_access` equals false) plus, only if a test shows it is still needed, `supervisor_convinced` equals false. First verify in incidents.yaml/storylet-routes.yaml that BOTH 2A outcome realizations set restricted_corridor_access (the exit trigger); if one does not, guard on the facts that cover both. For `purge_recovery_2c`: add `committed_to_transmit` equals false and `committed_to_rescue` equals false ONLY IF your tests show a 2C overlap; otherwise leave 2C data unchanged and keep the 2C tests as regression coverage. No retracts, no new facts, no prose, no precedence logic.
3. Every new test that proves a flaw must FAIL on the unfixed data: confirm by temporarily reverting your pacing.yaml change (git stash or git checkout -- the file, then restore) and running the new tests; say in your final message which test failed and how.

AUDIT REPORT (final message, a table): for each of 2A, 2C: event, what it guards before/after, outcome of the tests per timing (what facts were true), and whether it was changed. Also read (do NOT edit) the 1C recovery event/bridge and say whether it has the same flaw.

OWN ONLY: data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml, tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py.

RUN until green: tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py tests/test_2c_ledger_guard.py tests/test_stall_exit_audit.py tests/test_canon_journey.py tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py tests/test_incident_engine.py tests/test_incident_loader.py tests/test_incident_pressure.py tests/test_incident_recovery.py tests/test_pacing_handoff.py tests/test_scene_relative_pacing.py tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py tests/test_evidence_penalty.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py and every tests/test_2a_*.py, tests/test_2b_*.py, tests/test_2c_*.py, tests/test_3a_*.py file. Then ruff format + check on tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py.
tasks.verified: 2A recovery guarded after a choice; 2C proven by test (changed only if a test shows overlap); new 2A tests fail without the fix; focused suites pass

ROLE: JavaScript test maintainer. TASK: four tests in frontend/e2e are stale against the current Act 2 package (the Act 2 rebuild renamed and removed story data; the tests were never updated). Make each assert the CURRENT real package, keeping the same intent and the same strength. Never weaken: no deleting assertions, no `.skip`/`todo`, no loosening an exact deepEqual into a loose check, no catch-all. Edit test files only; never edit data/ or non-test frontend modules.

The four failures (run `node --test frontend/e2e/*.test.js` to see them):
1. frontend/e2e/authored-spans.test.js `loads entry variants by scene` (line ~41): asserts that real.entryVariantTextsBySceneId.get("2A") includes the old text "Kristin still has the copied prisoner numbers. She needs a way into the facility." Current 2A entry variants are in data/stories/continuity-initiative/plot.md (`entry_variants:` under scene 2A, ~line 358: texts "Kristin still has the copied prisoner numbers. The codes on the supervisor's work orders look like the same system." and "Brandon knows the service approach. If they get past this man, he can take them around the second checkpoint."). Update the expected string(s) to the current text exactly, and also assert the second 2A variant text so both are checked. Do not add a 2C expectation (2C has no entry variants now).
2. frontend/e2e/knowledge-available.test.js `builds chronological public knowledge and keeps same-turn deliveries out of before-turn evidence` (line ~64): `entry("k_sl_2c_a_r1")` no longer exists in data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml (the Act 2 rebuild removed it). Read the test and its helpers (`miniPlaythrough`, `entry`, `sceneCanon`, how `protected_facts` and `world_only` are derived) to understand what role that "private offer" entry plays: a 2C entry that is NOT yet available/established at 2C turn 0, shows up as a protected fact with `world_only: true`, and is never in knowledge_available_before_turn of later scenes. Choose the real current 2C knowledge entry that plays that role in the package (candidates: look at the 2C entries in knowledge.yaml and their audience / player_visible / world-only flags: the test's `protected_facts` entry has `world_only: true`, so choose an entry that the timeline code classifies that way, and if none of the current 2C entries is world_only, pick the closest and adjust the expected object to what the timeline code really emits for it, explaining why in a comment). Then update only the entry id; keep every assertion. If the miniPlaythrough fixture lists committed ids for scene 2C, update them to current ids so the scenario still exercises the same path.
3. frontend/e2e/package-clock.test.js `loads the real package and resolves turn milestones` and `reports conditional events in the real package pacing`: they refer to pacing event ids that no longer exist (`purge_2c`; the current id is `purge_window_2c`, scene 2C, at_turn 5) and a hard-coded `eventOrder` list (~lines 100-125) that still names old events (scrutiny_2a, cover_review_2a, archive_sweep_2b, transfers_2c, ...). Rebuild every expectation from data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml as it is now: the eventOrder list must equal the real event order the loader produces (print it with a short node snippet using loadPackagePacing, then verify it against pacing.yaml by eye: the loader's ordering rule is whatever package-clock.js implements; do not change package-clock.js), eventPoint("purge_window_2c") must equal the real object (scene_id "2C", target_turn 5, etc.), and the isConditional assertions must match which events have a `when`. Keep the shape of each assertion; replace values only. Where the test enumerates events of specific scenes, include ALL current events of those scenes.

After editing: `node --test frontend/e2e/*.test.js` must report fail 0. Final message: for each of the four tests, what the old expectation was and what it is now, and how you confirmed the new value against the data files.

OWN ONLY: frontend/e2e/authored-spans.test.js, frontend/e2e/knowledge-available.test.js, frontend/e2e/package-clock.test.js.

set -e
[ -e frontend/node_modules ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
for f in $(git status --porcelain | grep -v 'node_modules' | sed 's/^...//'); do
  case "$f" in
    frontend/e2e/authored-spans.test.js|frontend/e2e/knowledge-available.test.js|frontend/e2e/package-clock.test.js) ;;
    *) echo "WHY: edited file outside ownership: $f"; exit 1;;
  esac
done
for f in authored-spans knowledge-available package-clock; do
  P=frontend/e2e/$f.test.js
  OLD=$(git show HEAD:$P | grep -c "assert")
  NEW=$(grep -c "assert" $P)
  [ "$NEW" -ge "$OLD" ] || { echo "WHY: $P has fewer assert lines ($NEW) than HEAD ($OLD): do not weaken tests"; exit 1; }
  if grep -n -E "\.skip|\.todo|test\.only|describe\.skip|it\.skip" $P; then echo "WHY: skipped test in $P"; exit 1; fi
done
if grep -n "purge_2c\|k_sl_2c_a_r1" frontend/e2e/authored-spans.test.js frontend/e2e/knowledge-available.test.js frontend/e2e/package-clock.test.js; then echo "WHY: stale ids remain"; exit 1; fi
grep -q "purge_window_2c" frontend/e2e/package-clock.test.js || { echo "WHY: package-clock does not test the real purge_window_2c event"; exit 1; }
node --test frontend/e2e/*.test.js > /tmp/r6b.log 2>&1 || true
grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)|^ℹ (tests|pass|fail)" /tmp/r6b.log
grep -qE "^(# |ℹ )fail 0" /tmp/r6b.log || { grep -E "not ok|✖" /tmp/r6b.log | head -12; echo "WHY: node tests still failing"; exit 1; }
OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/act2-2c-yes
mkdir -p $OUT && git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 && git reset -q frontend/node_modules 2>/dev/null; git diff --cached > $OUT/r6b.patch && wc -l $OUT/r6b.patch && git diff --cached --stat | tail -6
